items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And I worked with him when he first came back and he didn’t have his regular band. And we went to Canada and different places.

ctx.x: Ebullient? You know one thing? I would go to Europe, me and Bobby — I worked with Bobby Hutcherson, mostly in the seventies, and we’d go to Europe a lot. And Dexter lived in Europe then. And he was the king of Europe, I am telling you. Everywhere Dexter played it’d be thousands of people. And he was just always real, and he’s just so tall and he was just so striking. And he would stay very, very polite and if he was going to play a song “Over the Rainbow” he’d say “Somewhere— Over the Rainbow — Way—” he’d say the…
Well I see one of my other favorite people on here and that is Jon Hendricks.
